text:
Preserve the accepted requirements and the now-valid public output contracts exactly, especially non-null products with required nullable name/description/price/error. Retain the current search, selection semantics, product visits, compact product-fact extraction/interpretation, bounded TSV formatting, actual writer, writer-derived outputs and finally cleanup. Make only these concrete review corrections using existing bindings; this limited structural revision authorizes replacing the single learned copying task by its deterministic projection counterpart.

1. Replace project_search_original_records_by_page (currently transform extract) with one pure foreach over open_search.observationSnapshot.pages. Its body needs no inference or operation: export recordArrays = field(item, "records") directly from that page. Use maxItems 100 (existing producer manifest cap). The enclosing output recordArrays is then the collected array of original record arrays, and the existing flatten_search_original_records should continue flattening that port. Preserve the complete original Browser record objects verbatim; do not invent a new record schema, key, action array or href. Already typed copying must require zero inference.
2. resolve_selected_original_records must lookup those flattened ORIGINAL records using port "reference" and the unchanged selected IDs. Keep resolve_selected_offers first with its existing strict key lookup and explicit dependency. Preserve IDs and repetitions exactly. In open_product_page, retain url = field(item,"href") but add the local requires predicate that this actual original href is non-null before dispatch; no cast or placeholder.
3. extract_search_candidates_by_page currently allows only ten candidates PER PAGE. That is not the global ten-product selection bound. The page can contain up to 200 producer records. Make its inner candidate array permit all candidates from that complete page (maxItems 200, matching the unchanged producer page cap); process every page and do not truncate/sample/deduplicate before selection. Keep the global selectedIds maxItems 10 and visit_products maxItems 10 unchanged. This changes no host/runtime/token ceiling.
4. On the existing page-consuming tasks, strengthen the explicit original snapshot requires to check captureTruncated == false and manifestTruncated == false, after its existing presence/success checks. Apply the same original-metadata checks before product-page extraction. These fields are producer contract metadata, not newly declared success flags.

Do not add new features, operations, notice handling, business filters, consumer fields, inference stages or unrelated restructurings. Do not change typed field semantics, nullability, accepted outputs or the successful writer's path. Return a fully validated plan preserving every unrelated binding and task.
